name: CDK4/6 Inhibitor (Palbociclib / Ribociclib) + Aromatase Inhibitor (Metastatic)
cyclesNote: Cycled every 28 days continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. For metastatic/advanced breast cancer only.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-P 2 of 3, BINV-Q 14 of 15)

biomarkers.note: Endocrine-based regimen: requires HR-positive (ER and/or PR positive) and HER2-negative disease. A CDK4/6 inhibitor (ribociclib, abemaciclib, or palbociclib) combined with an aromatase inhibitor is the preferred Category 1 first-line standard of care for HR-positive/HER2-negative recurrent or metastatic disease (ribociclib Category 1 with demonstrated overall survival benefit per MONALEESA-2/7). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-P (2 of 3) and BINV-Q (14 of 15). (Note: for curative early-stage adjuvant therapy, see dedicated adjuvant abemaciclib and ribociclib protocols).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes IDC and ILC)
supportiveCare: CBC before starting, on Day 15 of the first 2 cycles, then before each cycle (neutropenia monitoring).
For premenopausal patients on an aromatase inhibitor, give concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH analog) per BINV-P 1 of 3.
Monitor QTc if ribociclib is chosen (obtain ECG at baseline, Day 14 of Cycle 1, and Day 1 of Cycle 2).
monitoring: CBC with differential (neutropenia) per CDK4/6 schedule
Liver function tests before starting and periodically

doseModificationRules.text: Hold palbociclib until ANC recovers to grade ≤ 2 (≥ 1000/mcL). Resume at next lower dose (125 mg -> 100 mg -> 75 mg daily).

drugs.name: Palbociclib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Palbociclib 125 mg PO once daily on Days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle (7-day break). Sourced alternative CDK4/6 inhibitors include ribociclib 600 mg PO daily Days 1 to 21 (Category 1 with OS benefit) or abemaciclib 150 mg PO BID continuous Days 1 to 28.

drugs.name: Anastrozole
drugs.notes: Anastrozole 1 mg PO once daily on Days 1 to 28 (continuous). Letrozole 2.5 mg daily is a standard interchangeable nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor partner.
